text:
Mara: Planning cutover for MIG-20260320-7 (tenant_id_type change). Target window tonight 02:00 UTC. Need lock handoff and backfill gating.

deploy-bot: migration MIG-20260320-7 scheduled for 2026-03-20 02:00:00 UTC by @mara. Preflight checks pass. :white_check_mark:

Ryan: I'll be on lock duty. Plan to take exclusive lock at 01:55 UTC, hand to deploy at 01:58.

Sanam: Oncall for the window. If backfill > 4min or PG locks pile up, abort and revert to read-only routing.

Mara: Key checklist: 
- Canaries: 5% of tenants first two minutes
- Backfill rate cap: 200 rows/s (config in ops runbook)
- Rollback flag: feature.flag.tenant_id_swap = off

Kyle: What's the exact rollback command if we detect failure?

Mara: Short rollback path: toggle feature flag off, let traffic use old path, then run migration rollback job if needed. Manual SQL as last resort: 
```sql
-- last resort rollback snippet
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE tenants ALTER COLUMN tenant_id DROP DEFAULT;
-- revert any temporary PKs/indices created by MIG-20260320-7
COMMIT;
```

Sanam: For monitoring, add these quick checks after start: 
- `SELECT count(*) FROM migration_jobs WHERE id = 'MIG-20260320-7' AND status IN ('running');`
- `SELECT count(*) FROM pg_locks WHERE relation = 'tenants'::regclass;`

Ryan: I'll post lock acquisition log lines in thread when I take locks. If compaction/long vacuum shows up, we abort.

deploy-bot: preflight: replica lag 0.2s, disk free 120GB, connections 210/500.

Mara: Escape hatch: deploy fallback that pins to v1.13 of API binary (pin in service config) and flips routing to read-only replicas for 10m. If that doesn't work, we pause all writes at 02:05 and continue backfill offline.

ops-oncall: noted. I have the rollback checklist open (link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mig-20260320-7). Will coordinate DB admin if needed.

Ryan: taking locks now (01:55:12 UTC) -> `LOCK TABLE tenants IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;` Will hand to deploy in 3 minutes.

Mara: Copy. Deploy when canaries pass 2 min smoke (errors <0.5%). Post any errors here. Good luck :pray:

Sanam: If we see >5s p99 on write path during canary, I will cut and flip.

Ryan: handoff complete (01:58:45 UTC). deploy-bot, you have the go.

deploy-bot: MIG-20260320-7 STARTED at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z. Canary tenants: 5%. Streaming logs: https://logs.redwood/s/MIG-20260320-7

Mara: monitoring initial batch. posting smoke check in 2m.

Sanam: smoke after 2m: errors 0.2%, p99 write 180ms. proceeding to ramp.

Kyle: minor lock wait spike at 02:03 (30s), no blocked transactions beyond threshold.

Mara: ramping to full 100% over 6m. Keep eyes on backfill rate and pg_locks.

ops-oncall: leaving pager on. Ready to escalate to DBA if locks > 60s.

Mara: thanks team. I'll close thread after post-cutover verification and release notes snippet.

deploy-bot: MIG-20260320-7 COMPLETED at 2026-03-20T02:12:03Z. Post-run summary: 12k rows backfilled, average backfill rate 180 rows/s, no rollbacks triggered. :tada:
